svg.aria-label: Security advisories that credit HEY Research Lab: 148 filed privately on GitHub across 74 projects, 49 accepted or published, 42 published
svg.text: One square per advisory we filed privately on GitHub. Filled: published with our credit. Outlined: accepted by the team, not yet published.
Published: read daily from GitHub. Unpublished: counts only, as of 27 Nov. Policy: github.com/hey-research-lab/security
